title: Missing time: waking up by a reservoir dam near Newell
place_text: Reservoir dam near Newell, South Dakota

tellings.quote: The truck is parked behind the wall of a reservoir dam near a town called Newell, more than 8 miles from their post.

plain: In 1977, two Air Force men named Mario Woods and Michael Johnson are said to have come to in their truck with "missing time", meaning a stretch of time they could not account for. The truck was parked behind the wall of a reservoir dam near a town called Newell, South Dakota, "more than 8 miles from their post." Michels tells this himself in an episode where the two veterans meet again fifty years later, and he offers it as part of an account that, if true, would mean they were taken by something not human.
